messages:
opsbot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/infer from edge -> gateway. 5xx spike started ~2026-03-15T07:58:40Z. auto-triage tags: source=gateway, symptom=502/504 surge, window=10m, error_rate=~42%. Paging: @sam_oncall @maya_prod
sam_oncall: grabbing pager. seeing big 502 flood and backpressure on gateway clusters. graphs show sudden jump at ~07:59. checking recent config and deploys.
maya_prod: on call with you. any recent LB/envoy changes? i see a config apply at 07:52 by @devin_infra (commit e9c72a4) that altered route retry_policy + per-host connection cap.
devin_infra: confirmed. small canary: increased route-level retries from 2->6 and decreased host max_connections by 40% to force faster failover for a subset. I did not expect it to spike like this. starting rollback if that's needed.
opsbot: CONFIG_APPLY noticed: commit e9c72a4 applied to infra/envoy/routes (diff summary attached).
alex_platform: quick logs: envoy reports `upstream connect failed` followed by `upstream response timeout` and `retry loop exceeded`. cluster inference-backend-pool-03 shows many hosts UNHEALTHY around 07:59.
sam_oncall: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T07:59:05Z] envoy access: "POST /v1/infer" 502 - upstream_reset: reason=local_reset, details="socket hang up"
[2026-03-15T07:59:07Z] envoy warn: "retry loop: failed after 6 attempts" route="/v1/infer"
```
maya_prod: increasing retries + lowered concurrency is classic amplification. if retries escalate, in-flight requests multiply and CB ejects hosts. did CI/canary gate allow both changes together?
sre_lead: hypothesis matches signals. immediate mitigations we can try: (A) disable route retries at edge (fast) (B) restore host connection caps to previous value (C) un-eject hosts / mark unhealthy->healthy via admin. Which is quickest?
sam_oncall: i can hotpatch the route to set retries to 0 immediately. executing now.
sam_oncall: HOTPATCH payload:
```
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:9000/hotpatch \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"route": "/v1/infer", "retry_policy": {"num_retries": 0}, "request_timeout": "6s"}'
```
opsbot: HOTPATCH_ACK: patch accepted by control-plane (ack_id=1760601701).
maya_prod: monitoring: within 60s 5xx rate started falling — trending from 42% -> ~15%. latency still high but decreasing.
alex_platform: applying temporary CB/conncap bump on inference-pool-03 to prevent continued ejects:
```
PATCH /admin/clusters/inference-pool-03
{
  "circuit_breakers": {"max_connections": 5000, "max_pending_requests": 800}
}
```
opsbot: CB_UPDATE accepted (change_id=1760601728). health re-eval shows some hosts rejoining.
devin_infra: rolling back my commit e9c72a4 now (restore retries=2 and previous max_connections). initiating revert.
opsbot: ROLLBACK complete (revert_id=1760601750). routes restored to previous baseline.
sam_oncall: monitoring timeline: 08:00:20 error-rate -> 6%, 08:01:00 -> 2.3%. after 10m steady-state at ~1.1%. looks stable.
cs_lead: customer-impact: CS intake shows ~85 customers experienced transient failures; roughly 2500 failed requests total during window. opening notifications and support tickets.
sre_lead: incident severity: sev2. mitigation summary: hotpatch retries=0, temp CB/conncap bump, rollback of commit. assign postmortem.
devin_infra: initial RCA note: simultaneous increase in retries and reduction of host concurrency in same canary created retry amplification under normal burst traffic. ejects caused upstream UNHEALTHY flapping and 502s.
maya_prod: action items: (1) add CI lint that rejects combined changes that increase retries and decrease conn caps in same PR; (2) implement a runtime canary rule that prevents retry increases >+1 in canary; (3) add alert suppression window for config-rollout-originated error spikes so oncall isn't paged repeatedly for known rollout events.
sam_oncall: mitigation checklist done:
- route retries hotpatched to 0 ✅
- temporary CB/conncap increases ✅
- commit revert ✅
- CS notifications sent ✅
- postmortem assigned ✅
alex_platform: saving artifacts: envoy access logs, envoy admin dumps, commit diffs (e9c72a4), hotpatch commands, metrics snapshots (latency and 5xx graphs). pointing to docs PR.
opsbot: INCIDENT_CLEAR suggested: 5xx back to baseline for 12m. confirm before closure.
sam_oncall: holding 15m for stability, will close if steady. last 12m avg error_rate=0.9%. closing in 3.
cs_lead: customer message sent: "We mitigated an API availability disruption affecting inference requests between ~07:59-08:12 UTC. Root cause: configuration change triggering retry amplification and host ejections. Full postmortem forthcoming." :email:
sre_lead: post-incident tasks: add CI guardrails, update runbook for hotpatch rollback (include exact curl commands and admin endpoints), add monitoring playbook step to check for simultaneous retry/conncap diffs. assign to infra backlog.
devin_infra: creating postmortem draft: https://redwood-internal/docs/incidents/1760601600-rca-draft (owner: devin_infra). will include timeline and recommended CI checks.
maya_prod: final check: last_message window shows 0.7% error-rate over 15m. looks good. thanks for the rapid coord.
sam_oncall: closing incident thread. nice teamwork.
opsbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: duration ~13m, severity=sev2, postmortem_owner=devin_infra. Close thread or add notes.
